title: AI hourly news
description: Review sources, five-language drafts, evidence, Jev decisions and guarded publication.
pickOne: Choose a candidate from the list.
reason: Reason (required, kept in the audit log)
quickReasonList: A new development, not a duplicate
reasonFirst: Choose or type a reason to enable the buttons.
noSimilarTitles: No story of this category from the last 30 days to compare with.
doneRetry: Queued for a new draft. When it finishes it appears under To review, Needs redraft or Needs evidence.
doneVerify: Queued for re-verification. When it finishes it appears under To review or Needs redraft.
doneNotDuplicate: Recorded as not a duplicate; drafting has started. When it finishes it appears under To review or Needs redraft.
doneReject: Rejected. It is now under Rejected.
doneIncident: Reported. Auto-publishing for this category is off.
noDocument: No draft exists for this locale.
reviewHint: Candidates waiting for your decision: zh-TW drafts to confirm, possible duplicates Jev could not judge, confirmed stories stopped at translation or a check, and articles the final editor or Jev's last call held.
redraftHint: The AI stopped before a five-language draft existed, so there is nothing to publish. Run one again to draft it anew (spends model calls), or tick several and reject them together.
evidenceHint: Only lead-only pages, so there is nothing a draft could cite and no model was run. Reject them; coverage from an evidence source arrives as a new candidate.
closedHint: Rejected candidates and duplicates, for reference only.
bulkConfirm: Reject {count} candidates? This cannot be undone.

holds.news_locale_review_failed: A translation review did not pass
holds.news_claim_source_invalid: Cites a page outside the evidence
holds.news_event_date_invalid: Event date does not fit the sources
holds.news_not_eligible: Not newsworthy, according to the AI
holds.news_final_edit_hold: The final editor needs your decision

next.shadow: Jev approved all five languages; it was not published only because the scanner runs in shadow mode. Read the preview, then publish or reject it. Your decision is compared with Jev's for the auto-publish gate.
next.jevHold: The five-language draft is ready, but Jev held at least one language (see the assessments below). Read the preview: publish it if it is right; if something needs fixing, edit it in the guide editor and press Re-verify; reject it if it is not worth publishing. Your decision counts toward the auto-publish gate.
next.fixArticle: The edited article did not pass its checks again (reason above). Fix it in the guide editor and press Re-verify, or reject it.
next.duplicate: Jev could not tell whether this is the same event as a recent story. Compare it with the closest titles below. If it is a new development, press Not a duplicate, continue (drafting starts and spends model calls); if it is the same event, reject it.
next.evidenceChanged: A source page changed after the article was checked, so it cannot be published on the old check. Press "Re-check against the current sources": each source page is fetched again, and the saved five-language article goes through the fact check, the locale reviews and Jev's last call against the new text. It is published if they pass and comes back here if not; the fact check stops it when the new text no longer supports the article. Reject it if you do not want it.
next.redraft: The AI stopped before a five-language draft existed (reason above), so there is nothing to publish or edit. Run it again to draft the whole article anew (spends model calls), or reject it.
next.failed: Processing hit an error (message above). Run it again, or reject it.
next.needsEvidence: Only lead-only pages back this story, so there is nothing a draft could cite and no model was run. Reject it; coverage from an evidence source arrives as a new candidate.
next.published: Published. If you find a major factual or licensing error, tick the box below and report it: auto-publishing for this category switches off at once.
next.closed: Rejected or a duplicate. Nothing to do.
next.working: The AI is still working on this candidate. It appears under To review, Needs redraft or Needs evidence when it finishes.
next.zhDraft: The Traditional Chinese draft is written and passed the fact-checker's review against the sources. Check the preview: to publish, press "Confirm, translate and publish"; the other four languages are translated and published automatically after the final editor and Jev's last call. Reject it if not, or press "Run again" for a new version. Your decision is compared with Jev's for the agreement reference.
next.translationHold: You confirmed publication, but a translation or a check did not pass (reason above). Press Translate again and publish to try once more, or reject it.
next.readyToPublish: The edited five-language article passed every check. Publish it if it is right, or reject it.
next.finalEditHold: The final editor checked each language against the evidence and found a problem it cannot fix (see above and the assessments below). The five-language article is saved: if the preview is fine, press "Publish five locales"; to change it, edit it in the article editor and press "Re-verify"; reject it if it is not worth publishing.
next.jevFinalHold: All five languages passed the final editor, but Jev's last call did not approve at least one of them (see "Jev final review · last call" in the assessments below). If the preview is fine, press "Publish five locales"; to change it, edit it in the article editor and press "Re-verify"; reject it if it is not worth publishing.

reasonCodes.quota_unavailable: Jev's quota for today is used up
reasonCodes.semantic_duplicate_uncertain: Unsure whether it repeats a story

doneApprove: Confirmed. The other four languages are being translated; the article is published once the final editor and Jev's last call pass, or comes back to To review if not.
agreementHint: Automatic publication no longer waits for these figures: an article is published once the final editor and Jev's last call both pass. They only show how close Jev's judgement is to yours.
agreementProgress: {vertical} agreement with Jev (reference): you decided {labelled}, {rate}% agree
modelsManaged: The writer, verifier and final editor models are chosen under AI settings › Models by feature.
modelsTitle: News writing, fact-checking and final edit
modelsShadowNote: Changing a model leaves automatic publishing on; the agreement with Jev starts counting again, for reference only.
doneRefresh: The current sources were fetched and the article is queued for checking again. It is published if the fact check, the locale reviews and Jev's last call pass, and comes back to To review if not.
